contracts.uids: Preserve .gd.uid and scene/resource header UIDs; .godot is generated, not a migration source.
contracts.saves: Update codec/scene/definition/type paths and closed prefixes/native golden fixture in the same owner commit; version/reject changed paths, without old-save conversion.
contracts.discovery: Update parser/test/tooling/private-public scans and resource consumers with each owner; never leave old forwarding files.
contracts.scene_ownership: Headless only; raw .tscn edits require no opened/loaded editor-owned scene.
contracts.cycles: Resolve each responsibility cycle before that owner moves; no blanket domain DAG or wrappers.

decomposition.contract: NPC BT action/condition bases and physical NPC hierarchy import no Customer implementation. Split customer leaves/bases; E_DistrictNpc extends native NPC base, Customer appearance composes its own role. Role/home/service relationship bindings and delivery scenario belong customers. NPC body setup/reset emits producer-owned lifecycle requests/facts consumed by Customer owners; cadence stays System-owned.

Context creation and global panel/resource opening belong existing global UI glue; domain begin/end/eligibility/session APIs retain gameplay state. No domains import those UI constructors or contexts.

NPC physical intent belongs npc, common physical bodies/solvers belong motion. Input/focus/carry/access belong interaction; damage/attack and resistance policy belong combat; Customer combat adapter belongs customers. Public lower capability contracts cannot call their higher behavioral consumers.

Startup, Night persistence composition and serialization are consumers of domain-owned state/recipes. Domains publish facts/requests through producer-owned contracts; they never import Persistence implementation or global composition.

Shared ActorIdentityRules and BoundaryTrace use immutable shared actor identity contracts, without C_Package/C_NpcIdentity imports. Identity remains one authority with explicit immutable domain identity references; no mutable alias registry.

NpcLightZone is domain authoring geometry, NpcServiceRoutes belongs customer queue authoring. Remove Zone→LightingService registration implementation cycle using existing global native lifecycle composition. Customer route specialization feeds lower NPC physical intent/path inputs; NPC route base imports no customer authored route implementation.

Customer service/home-delivery trees belong customers and compose lower NPC emergency/combat/schedule capabilities. NPC base trees/Brain selection import no Customer trees or role implementation. Customer role assignment requests the native brain recipe through its explicit NPC operation; native due cadence/manual BT scheduling remains NPC-owned.

GameSessionService is existing global SceneTree/save-slot handoff composition, moved to content/scenes with no forwarding file. Persistence reset stops importing global panels; existing global UI lifecycle glue consumes the typed preparation boundary. S_NightSave declares after lower package work; lower package Systems stop importing the persistence scheduler. Time consumes producer-owned Night completion facts rather than C_Autosave.
